description: Rebuild Std 5-10 exam papers (articles id=paper-std-5 .. paper-std-10 in index.html) to EXACTLY match the user-provided question set captured verbatim in .agents/tasks/task-bilingual-and-std5-or/user-spec.md. Each paper must be fully BILINGUAL: Marathi primary + English, in the question AND in every option, every fill-in-the-blank choice, and BOTH columns of every match-the-following. Each paper totals exactly 20 marks. The new spec has NO 'OR / किंवा' internal-choice sections, so the D/E OR-question structure currently in Std 5-10 is replaced by the new विभाग A-E (Std 5-8) or A-F (Std 9-10) structure. This resolves the user's 'two missing OR questions in Std 5' point: the user's new Std 5 spec is the corrected paper (MCQ A=6, no OR).
